issues: Hero text contrast is slightly low on #f0f4f9 pastel background; readable but minor.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS and FRONTEND_URL in backend/.env still point to the e78c2a96 host while REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to assistant-chat-1 — same ingress route works today, but a future cross-origin direct call (not through the ingress) would be blocked. Keep both in sync when preview host changes.
ChatPage.send runs after stripping prompt/files; if backend returns an error (e.g. 413) the UI re-fills prompt+files which is good — verified for oversized file.

attachments.load_attachment on each turn re-reads image from disk and re-normalises through Pillow for every stream turn; fine for a few MB but could be cached per message_id to shave latency for images on long conversations.

chat._stream_reply emits only one 'title' event on first done; if the title generation call fails it silently falls back to the first user message truncated to 80 chars — acceptable but no 'retry title' affordance.
No max-conversations or max-files-per-conversation cap; a user could create unlimited rows. Low priority but worth tracking.
